description: Power System data for the North Sea region is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ehsan Nokandi, Jannis Kerl (Norwegian University of Science and Technology). The data presented is published as part of the iDesignRES project, specifically under WP 1, Task 1.1. This task involved collecting detailed energy system data, here for the North Sea region and focusing on electricity, to serve as test data for the models utilized within the iDesignRES project. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
